text:
maya: Hey team — quick sync. Predictive-prefetch initiative is hitting the prelaunch gate next week. Need signoff on launch criteria, fallback behavior, and infra/resourcing for tenant onramp. Who can confirm SLA targets and remediation playbook?
liam: I can take SLA numbers. For the pilot tenants we agreed 95th pct < 120ms p95 for small prompts, and < 300ms for 95th overall under committed Dedicated capacity. Is that the metric set you want in the doc?
maya: Yes pls. Also need an acceptance test for KV-cache warmup effectiveness (we saw ~30% p95 improvement in staging). Add a perf regression threshold: no more than 5% regression vs baseline.
tom: From infra: Dedicated pool can hit those numbers if we reserve 2x prewarm slots + burst policy for peak bursts. We need a clear on-call rotation for the first 72h. Ops can staff but need names.
anya: Security signoff: conditional. Need a short checklist for SSO/KMS access for pilot tenants, and retention rules on logs. Also requirement: no plaintext tenant data in shared buckets.
maya: OK — I'll add the SSO/KMS bullet. Can someone draft the short canary rollout config? Keep it simple: small % -> ramp -> fallback to smaller model.
liam: Draft config below:
```
canary: 5% # start
ramp: 5 -> 25 -> 100 over 6h
watch: p95_latency, error_rate, throttles
fallback: route->quantized-v2 if error_rate>1% or p95>2x baseline
auto-rollback: true
```
maya: Nice. Add an automated alert to Slack + Pager when fallback triggers. devex-bot: Reminder: Please attach the perf repro prompt set to the launch doc so evals can run nightly.
maya: Good call. I'll attach the eval set. Tom — can you confirm capacity commit timeline? We need pinned machines by Mon EOD.
tom: We can guarantee reserved capacity if Finance approves purchase order today. Otherwise we do provisional burst which may hit throttles.
maya: I'll nudge finance. Also negotiation point from customer success: they want tenant-specific SLA clauses for the top 3 customers in pilot. Can legal/ops accommodate?
anya: Legal needs standard phrasing but we can do tenant-specific addenda. Security needs to verify encryption-at-rest KMS mapping per tenant before sign.
liam: One more runtime note: if we enable prefix caching, memory footprint grows ~10% on the instance. Need that accounted in the reserved instance sizing.
tom: Noted. I'll add 12% headroom in the machine sizing worksheet.
maya: OK action items: 1) liam update SLA & fallback config in doc (by EOD) 2) tom confirm reserved capacity PO status and sizing (by EOD) 3) anya provide final security checklist (tomorrow AM) 4) maya attach eval prompts and finalize acceptance criteria (today). If all green, aim to open the gate Wed 09:00 PT.
liam: ack.
tom: ack :thumbsup:
anya: ack :eyes:
maya: Thanks all — will post the updated doc link when done: https://redwood-internal/notes/prefetch/gate-criteria
devex-bot: Deployment note: staging canary scheduled 1718400000. Make sure all owners are paged during rollout.
